title: Mobile top bar composition
question: Integrated top bar is locked. Which composition should we build? Approve, combine, revise, or reject — say what feels false.

options.label: Brand-led bar
options.thesis: SPORTSHUB + ORGANISER HUB own the header; menu is a quiet glyph beside the avatar — no floating tile.
options.viewport: Flush white sticky bar → greeting + Create event → KPI grid. Drawer closed.
options.risk: Hub wordmark competes with the page greeting for attention.

options.label: Section-title bar
options.thesis: The bar names where you are (Dashboard); Menu is labeled text — header serves wayfinding, not brand shout.
options.viewport: Logo mark + Dashboard + Menu + avatar → greeting and KPIs flush underneath.
options.risk: Loses ORGANISER HUB identity on every screen.

options.label: Avatar opens sheet
options.thesis: Same brand bar, but the avatar is the menu — tap opens the full sidebar sheet. No hamburger at all.
options.viewport: Brand bar + open left sheet with profile and full nav over dimmed dashboard.
options.risk: Avatar may read as profile-only until learned.
